items.title: FTI Consulting Adds Björn Storim to Strengthen Banking and Capital Markets Advisory in Germany
items.summary: FTI Consulting announced the appointment of Björn Storim, former CEO of BNY's European Bank, as a Senior Advisor in its Strategic Communications segment based in Frankfurt. With 35 years of international financial services experience, Storim will advise on banking, capital markets, regulation, and strategic transformation challenges for financial institutions across the EMEA region.

items.title: BNY Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Raised Outlook and AI Push
items.summary: Bank of New York Mellon (BNY) raised its 2026 operating leverage outlook to nearly 500 basis points with projected revenue growth of 12-13%, driven by strong Securities Services growth (up 15%), net interest income growth (up 15%), and deployment of over 400 AI solutions. The company beat earnings estimates with $5.68B in revenue and $2.37 EPS, while expanding digital asset capabilities and maintaining disciplined capital allocation.

items.title: BNY Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Fee Income & NII Growth
items.summary: Bank of New York Mellon (BNY) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.37, beating consensus estimates of $2.26, with a 24.1% year-over-year increase. Total revenues rose 11.7% to $5.68B, driven by higher fee revenues and net interest income. However, the company faces headwinds from rising expenses, deposit margin compression, and net outflows in assets under management. Capital ratios declined compared to the prior year.
